armGroups.label: Gemcitabine Combined With Endostar and Envafolimab
armGroups.description: Neoadjuvant therapy consisting of gemcitabine (1000mg/m2 d1,8) , endostar (150mg 3-day continuous infusion) and envafolimab (240mg d1) was given every 3 weeks for 3 cycles. Endostar, administered every 3 weeks (150mg 3-day continuous infusion), was given concurrently with intensity-modulated radiotherapy.

eligibilityModule.eligibilityCriteria:
Inclusion Criteria:

* Aged ≥65 years with newly pathologically confirmed NPC
* ECOG score: 0 to 1.
* Clinical stage III-IVA (Union for International Cancer Control and American Joint Committee on Cancer staging system for NPC, 8th edition)
* Adequate organ function

Exclusion Criteria:

* HBsAg positive with a hepatitis B virus quantification \> 1×10³ copies/mL or anti-HCV positive.
* Anti-HIV positive or AIDS diagnosis
* Active tuberculosis: within the past year.
* Active or suspected autoimmune diseases (e.g., uveitis, enteritis, hepatitis), excluding stable type I diabetes, treated hypothyroidism, or mild skin conditions
* Interstitial lung disease or pneumonia requiring oral or intravenous steroid therapy within the past year.
* Chronic systemic glucocorticoids or immunosuppressive therapy (≥10 mg prednisone/day); inhaled/topical corticosteroids permitted.
* Uncontrolled cardiovascular disease (e.g., New York Heart Association \[NYHA\] ≥ II heart failure, recent myocardial infarction, unstable angina, significant arrhythmias).
* History of other malignancies (except adequately treated non-melanoma skin cancer, in situ cervical carcinoma, or papillary thyroid cancer).
* Known allergy to envafolimab or its components.
* Active infection within a week requiring systemic therapy.
* Receiving a live vaccine within 30 days prior to first envafolimab dose
* History of organ transplantation.
* Any condition deemed by investigators to interfere with safety or protocol adherence (e.g., serious comorbidity, severe lab abnormalities, or psychosocial issues).
